BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Gula the Gourmet!!
The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
Wait a minute, the guy locked up in that huge\nprison...could it be...?!
Aye! It's Unda!
W-what are you guys doing here...?
We should be asking you that! After all that talk\nabout convincing the kingdom, now look at you,\nlocked up in a dump like this~.
I feel so terrible about it, but let's talk about\nthat later...Now you need to get outta here...\nThat thing will kill everyone when it gets here...
You mean the Gourmet?
How do you know that name...?!
Oh, you heard it from my men?\nDid you guys save them too? Sorry again, I really\nappreciate it.
My gosh! Something's coming up~!
It's here! Run, now!\nI'll take that Gourmet down even if it costs me my\nlife!
Do you even know what you're talking about?\nYou're literally chained up right now!
Boom chicka boom ♪
Rana meat today ♪ Rana meat tomorrow too ♪\nI eat Rana meat all year long ♪\nI'm sick of it~ ♪
This creature is the Gourmet?
What the hey is this ridiculous monster~?
Can't it see us?\nOr is it just deliberately ignoring us?
Boom ba da boom ♪
Sashimi today ♪ Grilled with butter tomorrow ♪\nIt's a dish with Rana every day, all day long ♪\nIt's time for me to eat something different~ ♪
Hmph, you must be in a really good mood to be\nhumming like that! Just so you know, if you wanna\neat me, it's not gonna be so easy!
I'm glad King Fubla kept his promise about the\nsacrifice, but...bam ba da bam ♪\nHe still doesn't get what I really want~.
*Sniff, sniff* What's this smell?\nIt's not Rana meat, I can tell from the smell that\nit's juicier and fattier...
Well, well, well! Where did you lot come from?
Seriously?! We've been standing here the whole\ntime!
Awesome~. That weredragon meat looks chewy, and\nLixi meat, I haven't had that in ages. And you two\nare...bam ba da bam ♪ meat from another world?
Oh, I can't wait to eat y'all~!
Oh my gosh! This thing wants to eat us!!
Aye! I'm not gonna lose!
Don't underestimate it! This thing is not\nnormal...
So you noticed it too, huh...?\nThis thing wasn't pretending that it didn't see\nus.
Just like we don't care about tiny bugs, we're\ninsignificant and invisible to it.
For sure, it's tough! Let's get our game faces on!
Slurrrrp slurrrp ♪ Time to eat~!!
A-are you gonna eat me? Uh, maybe steam me in\nwine? Oh, wait, actually, you should really try\ngrilling me with herbs~!
You actually beat the Gourmet...I knew you were\nmore than just an ordinary adventurer, but\nI didn't expect you to be this good.
Well, that's because this adventurer has been\nunder my personal care all this time. That should\nexplain everything.
Yeah, right. Says someone who's always clutching\nthe adventurer's leg and trembling like a scared\npuppy...
What? Are you sure that's me, not Anono?
Aye? I dunno. I don't think I've ever done that!
Hahaha, cut it out, guys!\nAll four of you are absolutely special, no doubt\nabout it!
So you're a Lixi...It could have gone badly.
Aye?
I heard the Gourmet loves Lixis.
...I hate it though...
By the way, how did you get yourself chained up in\na place like this?
My older brother, Fubla, the king for the time\nbeing, ordered them to do it. After parting ways\nwith you guys, I returned to my homeland, Raela,
the undersea kingdom. As I told you before, the\npurpose was to get them to join us to fight\nagainst Coenubia.
Who would've guessed you were the heir to the\nthrone~?
I guess I was being naive.
I never cared about being the king and gave up the\nposition on my own, partly to keep things stable\nin Raela. I thought my brother would get that.
When I came back, he immediately assumed that\nI was plotting to usurp the throne.
Ah, that's why they caught you.
From what I've heard, Raela's governance is a\nmess now, and everyone is fed up. My brother\nprobably feels guilty about it too.
Tch, he's always so quick to jump to conclusions!\nI've told him so many times since I was a little\nkid that I have no desire for the throne...
Really, countless times...
Sir, what about the Gourmet?
It must be full right now, so it won't attack us.
I think we had a similar conversation before, and\nthere were victims then...
My gosh! Some people are coming~!
Those soldiers are coming to see if I'm dead!\nIt's a large force. If we take them on, we won't\ncome out unscathed.
Oh no!\nThis tower is just like a conch shell.\nThere's only one way in and out.
Nope...
A secret exit~!
This is something I checked out earlier in case we\nneeded to escape. It's a ventilation shaft.\nIt's narrow, but we can get out through it.
...A ventilation shaft?
No way!\nYou mean a creature that fits inside this giant\nshell actually existed?!
Huh?\nNo, I'm not sure about that...But anyway, we've\ngotta get outta here now!
Alright! Let's go!
Ew, a conch as huge as this?\nEven just thinking about it is kinda gross~.
Pelulu!!
Alright, alright! I'm coming~!
